provenance: Supplied retrospective optical, electrochemical and fluorescence observations.

acceptor.qualification: Source-reported reduction condition; a reversible equilibrium couple is not established here.

quenching.lifetime_observation: The lifetime ratio is essentially independent of quencher concentration over the plotted domain.
quenching.raw_individual_points_and_instrument_err: Raw decay traces, unrounded measurements and pointwise instrumental uncertainties are unavailable. The rounded normalized lifetime ratios below are published summary observations, not raw decay data.

excitation_source_annotations.measurement: steady-state emission spectra with added quencher

quenching.excitation_qualification: Two supplied experimental annotations disagree; no unique corrected excitation wavelength is established.

tabulated_lifetime_ratios.qualification: Rounded reported ratios only; no raw decays, absolute lifetime at each concentration, replicates or pointwise errors are supplied. Printed precision is not an instrumental uncertainty. Interpret together with the intensity plot; the table alone does not identify a quenching mechanism or equilibrium population.

electrode_ambiguity: The reported Ag/AgCl-to-SCE conversion is −0.05 V under the measured conditions; inconsistent reference labels remain unresolved. Preserve the supplied SCE values without assuming a universal offset.

time_resolved_measurement.qualification: A separate time-resolved measurement. Its excitation does not resolve the 373/410 nm steady-state discrepancy; its fitted lifetime uncertainty is not the error of every quenching-plot point.
time_resolved_measurement.scope: 375 nm applies to donor 1a; donor 1e uses its explicitly listed 440 nm setting.

observations.definition: Monoexponential decay lifetime, not the separate microsecond delayed component.
Reported average lifetime of a multiexponential decay; not a single decay component.
observations.qualification: A tri-exponential fit and 440 nm excitation are reported. The averaging formula and uncertainty of the quoted average are unspecified.

absolute_excited_state_lifetimes.qualification: These are source experimental observations, not computed results or a derivation from normalized lifetime ratios. They do not resolve the separate373/410nm steady-state excitation discrepancy. Absolute molecular reaction rates do not follow from these observations alone.
